entry.title: Your AI wrote you a course. Then it got stuck in the chat.
entry.summary: A model drafts a course in a minute. Then it stays in a chat or an artifact that never asks you anything again. What that costs, and how Minute Studio turns the draft into practice you can share.

entry.title: You are not a goldfish
entry.summary: Short courses are sold on the claim that our attention has shrunk below a goldfish’s. Nobody can find where that came from. The better case is stranger: practice spread over days works because it feels harder, and that feeling is exactly what fools us.
